interpretations: Group products by `production_type_code` and average each type’s non-NULL `unit_price`. If the average of all non-NULL product prices exists, retain types whose average exceeds it. Compute the unweighted mean of those retained type averages, then retain only types above that mean. Return one row containing the mean of the final type averages, the mean of their differences from the overall product average, and the mean of their differences from the retained-type mean.
queries:
WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY production_type_code
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS product_average
    FROM Products
),
retained_types AS (
    SELECT t.type_average
    FROM type_averages AS t
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE t.type_average > o.product_average
),
retained_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_of_retained_types
    FROM retained_types
)
SELECT
    AVG(r.type_average) AS final_mean,
    AVG(r.type_average - o.product_average) AS mean_difference_from_overall,
    AVG(r.type_average - m.average_of_retained_types) AS mean_difference_from_retained
FROM retained_types AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
CROSS JOIN retained_mean AS m
WHERE r.type_average > m.average_of_retained_types
